CHAPTER 14 · ITEM 11 / 12

Short run and long run

Short run and long run短期與長期

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Distinguish fixed inputs in the short run from the ability to vary all inputs and plant scale in the long run.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

短期有部分投入或規模固定；長期可改全部投入，包括廠房和退出。長短期由調整所需時間決定，沒有通用月份界線。

In the short run, some inputs or plant scale are fixed. In the long run, all inputs can be adjusted, including entry, exit and plant size. The relevant horizon depends on how long adjustments take, not a universal number of months.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：A bakery can hire overtime this week but needs months to install a larger oven. The oven is fixed in the short run.

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Which is possible in the long run? 長期可以怎樣？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
